strings.app.name: Network Device Watchdog
strings.app.started: Watchdog started: {count} device(s), checking every {interval} s, alert after {threshold} failed checks in a row.
strings.app.configInvalid: The configuration in {path} has errors and was not loaded:
strings.app.configNotFound: Configuration file not found: {path}. Create one with --init.
strings.app.configCreated: Sample configuration written to {path}. Edit it and start the watchdog again.
strings.app.installed: Installed: the watchdog will start when you log on. Configuration: {path}
strings.app.uninstalled: Uninstalled: the watchdog will no longer start when you log on.
strings.app.installLinux: Created {path}. Enable it with: systemctl --user enable --now network-device-watchdog
strings.alert.body.test: This is a test alert from the Network Device Watchdog. Press OK to close it.
strings.log.notifierFailed: Could not send the alert through {notifier}: {error}
strings.msg.unreachable: {host} does not answer ping. Check that the device is powered on, its network cable and switch port, and whether its IP address changed.
strings.msg.ipConflict: {ip} is answered by MAC address {seen}, but the device has {expected}. Another device is using its IP address.
strings.msg.portBlocked: {host} answers ping, but TCP port {port} does not accept connections ({detail}). The port may be held by a stale connection, or the device's network interface stopped responding.
strings.msg.portBlocked.rawHint: Run 'netstat -ano | findstr :{port}' on the other computers and check tablets or apps that print to it directly.
strings.msg.noResponse.escpos: TCP port {port} accepts the connection, but the printer does not answer the status request ({detail}). The printer stopped reading data. Check its lights before restarting it.
strings.msg.noResponse.ipp: The printer accepted the connection but did not answer the IPP status request ({detail}).
strings.msg.queueError: The device is OK, but in the Windows print queue "{queue}" job {job} ("{document}") is in state: {status}.
strings.msg.jobStuck: This computer has been sending a job to {host} for {count} checks without finishing. The printer stopped reading data in the middle of the job. Check its lights before restarting it.
strings.msg.http.body: {url} answered, but the response does not contain "{text}".
strings.reason.stoppedPaperEnd: stopped because it is out of paper
